UI_GFL2_Biography_GFL2Laiya: If this Doll seems warm and friendly, you've probably stepped into her trap already. If you notice too late, Leva takes no responsibility for whatever it costs you. Unless, of course, it's you. “Commander, you wouldn't lose on purpose, would you? Hehe. That's all right. How would you like me to make it up to you?”
UI_GFL2_Biography_GFL2Cheyanne: A cautious, reserved Tactical Doll who keeps her abilities to herself. Words seldom come easily to her, and praise makes her blush. She is always exploring unfamiliar fields and picking up new skills, even when they have little to do with her duties. That quiet passion lies hidden beneath her calm exterior, like a pearl under the dust. It takes a perceptive Commander to see her shine. “…I only know a little. You don't need to praise me… I'm just an ordinary Tactical Doll.”
UI_GFL2_Biography_GFL2Asteria: A member of the AR Team, she is now more composed than she used to be. After losing M4 and later parting from the Commander, she learned to value the companions at her side even more. She cares about results, has little to say about her methods, and seldom defends herself. That often leaves others with the wrong impression. Only after she has quietly done so much do they realize how much she cared. This is her own gentle way of looking after others.
UI_GFL2_Biography_GFL2Koleda: Once the lead wolf of DEFY. After the worst day of her life, she saw her comrades through their final watch and entrusted the title and burden of leadership to someone worthy of both. She found another way to keep fighting. She is still the AK-12 you remember. Take care, though: she is more dangerous now. “A good snow wolf uses the snow to hide. I'm better. Even dressed all in white, I can disappear into the dark.”
UI_GFL2_Biography_GFL2Nikketa: An officer who fights for justice, a kind big sister to children, and a spender who can empty her wallet without blinking. Why shouldn't all three be the same person? Nikketa stands on the front line and lives by her principles with a cool head, but you get to see a different side of her. “My work taught me never to trust anyone completely. You're the exception, Boss. We're partners in the pursuit of justice, after all.”
UI_GFL2_Biography_GFL2Florence: A medical Doll drawn to excitement and pleasure. She's frank and knows how to tempt people. Her medical skills are exceptional, and she's passionate about mixing medicines, though others can find her enthusiasm a little much. “Which would you like: this pill, this syringe, or my punishment? Any of them will feel reeeally good.”
UI_GFL2_Biography_GFL2Alva: A Tactical Doll with a cool exterior and a delicate heart. Her offhand replies can sound indifferent, yet she takes other people's needs and opinions seriously and looks for a chance to help. She notices the little reactions and feelings most people miss. She's sensitive to her surroundings, and the mood around her can rub off on her. “I thought time would change a lot of things… But you haven't changed, and neither have we. Only the world changes every day.”
UI_GFL2_Biography_GFL2Centaureissi: A humble, principled Doll. She brews fragrant coffee and steadfastly guards the café. There is no replacing her as Zucchero's shield.
UI_GFL2_Biography_GFL2Springfield: Gentle, strong, and quick to understand others, she can move with tact among all kinds of people without lowering her guard. Behind her patience is a firm conviction. Springfield has one rule: protect her friends and everyone dear to her.
UI_GFL2_Biography_GFL2Faelynn: Painful, stifling secrets crowd Faelynn's memories, yet there is still a trace of brightness in her mind. Even the darkest cloud is lit by the warm sun of innocence. “Master, however long you're away, I'll… I'll be good and wait for you to come home!”
UI_GFL2_Biography_GFL2OTs14: A calm, serious third-generation Doll, proud and sure of herself. Her modifications gave her unrivalled strength and made her tougher than before, enough to keep the unease and vulnerability beneath the surface well hidden. “How's today's plan coming along, Commander? Let me hear a little of it, too.”
UI_GFL2_Biography_GFL2Daiyan: A gentle, reserved Doll who carries her guzheng from place to place with her companions in the Monsoon Band. When she plucks the strings, she brings out the wishes her listeners have buried deepest. She listens to it all and embraces it all.
UI_GFL2_Biography_GFL2Klukai: Elegant, composed, and utterly self-assured, Klukai is determined to make every member of H.I.D.E. 404 an elite. Only those close to her know how much tenderness and affection lies behind that demanding exterior.
UI_GFL2_Biography_GFL2Suomi: A kind, earnest Doll with a strong sense of duty. She sets out bravely for her community and travels far to find the people she cherishes. You can count on her to deliver on both your trust and the task you give her.
UI_GFL2_Biography_GFL2Cecilia: A gentle, warm Tactical Doll who earns her companions' trust through her honest, caring nature. She's especially good at being the understanding little sister who listens to their worries and helps untangle them. Years of working on her own after leaving Griffin sharpened her gifts until words and insight became her unique weapons. To help the Commander out of danger, she set off as a negotiator on a journey with no certain end. She believes her maturity and newfound resilience will let her find that sliver of hope for a reunion in the chaos.
UI_GFL2_Biography_GFL2Qiuhua: Warm, frank, and bursting with optimism and energy. As a food hunter in the Yellow Zones, Qiuhua looks for new ingredients so fewer people go hungry. Lending a hand when she sees trouble is second nature, and she'll never let a conversational opening go to waste. “I still can't get behind putting ketchup in guobaorou. But if that's how you like it, I guess I can live with it.”
UI_GFL2_Biography_GFL2Soppo: An energetic Doll who loves a fight. She likes getting straight to the point and rarely overthinks things. She trusts her teammates without reservation and follows every order you give her. “Commander, what are we doing next? Haven't decided? Then… let's go play together!”
UI_GFL2_Biography_GFL2Sextans: An agile Doll with a knack for planning. Once under the Orlog Conglomerate's authority, she was discarded after failing an important mission and suffered severe damage to her neural cloud. Rescued by the Elmo, she became someone the crew could rely on. “Compared with my former colleagues, the Dolls around you do seem a little… innocent.”
UI_GFL2_Biography_GFL2Yohee: Passionate, responsible, and devoted to dance. The Commander's praise set her on the path to becoming a dancer. To live up to her role as a mentor, she founded Spark and gave more wandering Dolls somewhere to belong. She works tirelessly at her craft. Curiosity and discipline keep her moving, while sheer determination carries her to her goals. You can trust her. When Yoohee promises something, she sees it through. “Keep up with the beat. Let's bring the house down!”
UI_GFL2_Biography_GFL2Macqiato: Cool, proud, and awkward about showing her feelings. She likes fluffy little animals and macchiatos with far too much sugar. She usually keeps to herself, yet her gaze always seems to linger in one direction. When will she finally get the answer she's been waiting for?
UI_GFL2_Biography_GFL2Destroyer: A frank, sharp-tongued Sangvis Ferri Doll. Lycoris poured special care into her creation and gave her the name Maria. From the battlefield where Sangvis Ferri fell to years of exile in the Red Zone, she's kept a simple heart. She gives her wholehearted trust only to the person she has chosen: you. “Of course I'll follow all your orders, Commander. What's so strange about that? Surely you can handle a little thing like giving orders!”
UI_GFL2_Biography_GFL2Vector: A Doll who habitually expects the worst. As the leader of H.I.D.E. 404's Second Squad, though, Vector stays to the very end and faces hardship with her team, no matter how bleak the odds her calculations turn up.
UI_GFL2_Biography_GFL2Phaetusa: Gentle and accepting as a spring breeze, or sharp and proud as cold steel. The first is Phaetusa; the second is Scavenger. This Doll holds two minds in one body. One was born of a wish to protect the best of human civilization, the other from the wreckage of Sangvis Ferri's war. They met amid the fighting, saved each other, and chose to carve out their own path together in troubled times.
UI_GFL2_Biography_GFL2Lenna: A cheerful, approachable Doll who gives everything to protect the family she treasures. She's grown more composed and faces the outside world with a perfect smile. Whenever she sees her family, she still insists on giving them a heartfelt hug.

UI_GFL2_OutfitDescription_pmx-76a4aa1594: “If there comes a day when we no longer have to fight... I think I'd like to spend my school days with you.” She smooths the hem of her skirt after the wind lifts it. Your reflection catches in her gentle eyes.
UI_GFL2_OutfitDescription_pmx-225af1a054: “Commander, take my hand and listen to the sea breeze with me.” Springfield smiles and tips the brim of her hat, inviting you to share a warm island afternoon.
UI_GFL2_OutfitDescription_pmx-06925f50fb: “You're a Commander I can put my faith in. Let's walk side by side, always...” OTs-14 slowly comes toward you. A scene she rehearsed countless times in her neural cloud is finally within reach.
UI_GFL2_OutfitDescription_pmx-8a28434eee: “I told you I'm all you need. Ready to spend the rest of your life proving it?” Under the indigo sky, her snow-white dress shines for you alone. She laces her fingers through yours, her gaze unwavering. The future she calls perfect is now in your hands.
UI_GFL2_OutfitDescription_pmx-c7270af966: “Still smarting from that volleyball game you lost years ago, Commander? Heh, I'll give you a rematch if you like.” Koleda settles back with a widening smile and waits to see how you'll answer.
UI_GFL2_OutfitDescription_pmx-f5b2807685: “As you wish, Boss. The pact we made tonight is sealed... Now see it through to the end.” Nikketa tries to keep her usual stern expression, but her flushed ears give her away.
UI_GFL2_OutfitDescription_pmx-5efe7392a2: “B-bathe together? I already got out! Well... I suppose I could go back in. Honestly, I waited and waited. Where were you?” Makiatto has barely finished putting on her robe when her strength gives out and she collapses.
UI_GFL2_OutfitDescription_pmx-d373f73abd: “Commander, you're blushing. Well? Which gets your heart racing more, this feast or me?” With steam rising all around, the bunny lifts the covers to reveal a feast for the eyes and the palate.
UI_GFL2_OutfitDescription_pmx-74fa40dba7: “Hmph. I know you better than any other Doll, so of course I'm the natural choice to be your maid.” Klukai tips up her chin and serves your first cup of black tea for the day with perfect confidence.
UI_GFL2_OutfitDescription_pmx-7d46f9b715: “Get in, Commander, or I'll take off without you!” The engine's roar snaps you back to the moment. In the wave of heat, her mischievous little fang catches the light. Seat belt on. Ready to lead the pack with Soppo?
UI_GFL2_OutfitDescription_pmx-abe3eaaaa9: Leva's usual outfit. The uniform is a symbol of reason, with her own personality woven into it. She goes her own way and still knows where to draw the line. That contradiction is part of what makes Leva so captivating.
UI_GFL2_OutfitDescription_pmx-48650a04a3: Cheyanne's usual outfit. Dark and understated, its loose cut covers the vital parts of her torso and makes her feel safe. As for what she's capable of, she prefers to keep that hidden, too.
UI_GFL2_OutfitDescription_pmx-0af2162657: “Commander, you don't seem to know where to look. Need me to help you with that?” Sunlight follows her outline. Her sweat-soaked clothes cling to her skin, tracing a figure full of energy.
UI_GFL2_OutfitDescription_pmx-412bd03730: Asteria in her usual outfit. She brings her past and present together as she looks for a path of her own, holding on to who she has always been.
UI_GFL2_OutfitDescription_pmx-b0dd2e3cfd: “We climbed to an open mountaintop to watch the stars in the cold wind... Is this what you call romance, Commander? Then come a little closer, please.” Asteria watches you, her gaze fixed on something more precious than the stars. Without a word, she wraps her scarf around your neck.
UI_GFL2_OutfitDescription_pmx-020abca186: Alva's usual outfit. A special operations uniform built for work, with almost nothing in the way of decoration. It gives her room to move and holds up under heavy combat in any environment.
UI_GFL2_OutfitDescription_pmx-9ee1e4cdb8: “Want to try something new on the water? Come surfing with me, then. You can count on me to make it worth your while, even out here.” She rides the wave toward you and holds out her hand. Ready to meet that expectant look, Commander?
UI_GFL2_OutfitDescription_pmx-fee7d92be4: Cecilia's usual outfit. Beneath its cool, professional exterior is a gentle and considerate heart.
UI_GFL2_OutfitDescription_pmx-9db646f49c: “You've been working hard, Commander! Come take a break. I've made you some hot black tea today.” Cecilia smiles gently and offers a warm afternoon tea to the person who matters most to her.
UI_GFL2_OutfitDescription_pmx-94483c23f6: “Commander, the area is clear. I'm your assistant now, Antje... I never thought I'd use that name again.” Working as your bodyguard in disguise, she keeps close, even closer than usual.
UI_GFL2_OutfitDescription_pmx-47a4f99939: “I'm sorry. I'm not very good at gatherings like this. Commander, please show me... what I'm supposed to do...” She blushes from nerves. Her stiffness gives away how new this is to her. Cheyanne looks to you with watery eyes, like a startled fawn asking for help.
UI_GFL2_OutfitDescription_pmx-efe6854650: Klukai's usual outfit. Her ultramarine coat makes her the most conspicuous figure on the battlefield. She's perfectly happy to draw the enemy's eye. In fact, that's why she chose it.
UI_GFL2_OutfitDescription_pmx-6826e4ccdf: Klukai's riding suit. The fitted silver-white fabric outlines her figure. Like wind or lightning, the shining silver rider extends an invitation. Hop on. Let's go for a ride!
UI_GFL2_OutfitDescription_pmx-a0790aac2b: Klukai's tactical riding suit. It gives her protection and freedom to fight, letting her race across the front line like a flash of blue.
UI_GFL2_OutfitDescription_pmx-1c1dd06981: “Oh, are you sure you want to follow me, Commander? If you get lost, that's on you.” Leva gives you an easy, confident smile as she tries to lure you deeper into the maze.
UI_GFL2_OutfitDescription_pmx-4f5d642f97: Vector's usual outfit. Its subdued colors help her hide her tracks, giving her a head start in combat.
UI_GFL2_OutfitDescription_pmx-ba77d8becc: “I still have a lot to work on. If you have any suggestions, Commander, you can tell me straight.” She looks at you sincerely, with a trace of worry still in her eyes.
UI_GFL2_OutfitDescription_pmx-1303e831f7: “Commander... What kind of operation was this outfit meant for, exactly? Come to think of it... Was that Ruchey screaming?” Vector refuses the bunny ears, saying they'd get in the way in combat.
UI_GFL2_OutfitDescription_pmx-d1fc22f957: Destroyer's usual outfit. The jet-black combat suit outlines her small frame. Like a hound lying in wait in the shadows, she's always ready to tear into her prey.
UI_GFL2_OutfitDescription_pmx-d9972c9c00: “Making the great Destroyer wait on you... You'd better be ready for this! W-wait, hands off the tail!” She tilts her chin up haughtily. The swish of her tail gives away how she really feels.
UI_GFL2_OutfitDescription_pmx-7834ce1969: “I go to more parties now than I used to. Still, the one I'm looking forward to the most... I haven't had an invitation yet, Commander.” She keeps her amused eyes on you, waiting for an answer.
UI_GFL2_OutfitDescription_pmx-782f06826a: OTs-14's usual outfit. Its cool colors conceal a sharp edge. Of all the paths she might take, she'd rather stay beside you, a shadow that belongs to you alone.
UI_GFL2_OutfitDescription_pmx-b6fa1b6b34: Faelynn's usual outfit. She left off most of her everyday decorations to get the most out of it in battle. Through the long wait, her longing became something to fight for.
UI_GFL2_OutfitDescription_pmx-90268b4961: With Alva's careful help, Koleda's new frame wears an outfit that looks as close as possible to the one she used to wear. A great deal has changed inside. She's still the same Koleda.
UI_GFL2_OutfitDescription_pmx-8c817aa0fd: Daiyan's usual outfit. The distinctive cut and flowing patterns show her refined taste.
UI_GFL2_OutfitDescription_pmx-8fc5b665a5: Centaureissi's usual outfit. A gun sling is tucked under her spotless uniform. She brews a fine cup of coffee and keeps a watchful eye on the people she serves.
UI_GFL2_OutfitDescription_pmx-4cdf23692c: Nikketa's usual outfit. Her spotless blue security uniform shows how seriously she takes justice. She aims to be a nightmare to criminals and a model for everyone who protects children's smiles.
UI_GFL2_OutfitDescription_pmx-4019c9450e: Suomi's usual outfit. Warm winter clothes practically call for a fur collar and fluffy pom-poms.
UI_GFL2_OutfitDescription_pmx-f6ac57de07: Lenna's usual outfit. It works just as well for sneaking through the night as it does for fighting on the front line.
UI_GFL2_OutfitDescription_pmx-a3c2d1b094: Phaetusa's usual outfit. Sleek and easy to move in, it still bears a few traces of her past as she steps into a new era by your side.
UI_GFL2_OutfitDescription_pmx-caaf00b5aa: Sextans's usual outfit. It's well suited to moving in the dark. Watch out for her nighttime ambushes.
UI_GFL2_OutfitDescription_pmx-2689b8bef5: Yoohee's usual outfit. Youthful, nimble, and light on her feet. She moves freely between styles, always looking to share her love of life with everyone in the audience.
UI_GFL2_OutfitDescription_pmx-a030b24c02: Springfield's usual outfit. Its elegant colors lend her a quiet dignity that earns people's respect. Her warm smile soon puts them at ease.
UI_GFL2_OutfitDescription_pmx-23b0b754d2: Florence's usual outfit. White for purity and professionalism is paired with a calm black. The combination leaves her free to move and brings out her mature charm.
UI_GFL2_OutfitDescription_pmx-0b80022fae: Makiatto's usual outfit. She seldom opens her violin case. It holds the weapon she treasures most.
UI_GFL2_OutfitDescription_pmx-e4fe174c77: Qiuhua's usual outfit. Fiery as her personality, light enough to move quickly. It makes setting up a stove and a wok easy, so she can cook up a pot of hope for people in desperate times.
UI_GFL2_OutfitDescription_pmx-40dbcd572c: Soppo's usual outfit. Its light, airy cut does little to hide her enthusiasm. She decided long ago that she wants to build the future together with you.
UI_GFL2_OutfitDescription_pmx-4818f3bdda: “Bonne année chinoise! Oh, that look on your face, Commander... Do you want to try something exciting with me again? Don't worry. This time it won't be fireworks.” Florence wraps her arms around you from behind, ready to find a new thrill together.
UI_GFL2_OutfitDescription_pmx-7c5ea1f673: “Commander, cold drinks and shaved ice are delicious in the summer. Please try to have them in moderation.” A lounge chair, a parasol, and the beach. She's arranged everything for a quiet summer getaway by the sea.
UI_GFL2_OutfitDescription_pmx-293917f24c: “Master, Master! Come play with me! I'm really good at these games!” She waves both hands at you, all the energy of a little sun in motion.
UI_GFL2_OutfitDescription_pmx-33aa225b75: A restrained palette as elegant as flawless jade. The tailored cut brings out the wearer's graceful outline.
UI_GFL2_OutfitDescription_pmx-43ef6f5967: Suomi's beach outfit. Its colorful ribbons look like a fish's tail. Wearing it, Suomi becomes the happiest little sprite in the sea.
UI_GFL2_OutfitDescription_pmx-73625fbf09: “Whatever form I take, past, present, or future, I'll always be your OTs-14.” There isn't a trace of doubt in her eyes. Her resolve to protect you is plain to see.
UI_GFL2_OutfitDescription_pmx-dd77c17324: “I've been recognized for my work. It's my duty to serve you in a way that lives up to that honor. Commander, please try this.” She fills your cup and hopes the coffee she prepared with such care will earn your approval.
UI_GFL2_OutfitDescription_pmx-78cbbc06c7: “Come on! Keep it up! Fight on! I adapted this from clothes I designed for the children. This outfit saw them grow up... and saw me grow, too.” She dances like the bright sun, lifting people's spirits with energy and warmth.
UI_GFL2_OutfitDescription_pmx-ea3eb50ef5: “Boss, come a little closer. Let me... take your arm.” Her deep-blue dress is like a bay at night. At this moment, a crimson ripple crosses the water.
UI_GFL2_OutfitDescription_pmx-62b44285b5: “You've worked hard, Commander. Would you like a coffee? The sweetness and the temperature... Both just the way you like them.” Like every cup she's served you before, this one was made with your tastes in mind.
UI_GFL2_OutfitDescription_pmx-cb19e5961c: “Commander, your Christmas present is here! Would you like to open it?” Suomi walks straight toward you, hands empty and cheeks red.
UI_GFL2_OutfitDescription_pmx-67f783c266: A gift from the Commander to Lenna. From the cute flowers to the playful bows, every detail suits her.
UI_GFL2_OutfitDescription_pmx-b8a56876e5: She hides herself and her secrets in the night, quietly keeping everything she loves safe.
UI_GFL2_OutfitDescription_pmx-81a5c871af: “Good day, Commander. May I invite you to the coming tea party? Today's drink is black tea with roses I picked myself.” Amid the flowers she holds out her hand, hoping to draw you into her own fragrant shadows.
UI_GFL2_OutfitDescription_pmx-e177f4382e: “Your Excellency... Is this outfit to your liking? It's a little cold tonight, and your hands are so warm. May I hold your hand?” An alluring smile tugs at the corners of Sextans's eyes.
UI_GFL2_OutfitDescription_pmx-9de435d362: “Commander, now I'm going to cast a spell to make you happy!” She has eyes only for you, longing to see you smile.
UI_GFL2_OutfitDescription_pmx-cc787cf2d0: Under the lamplight, she outshines every jewel. Even the hint of a gentle smile is enough to hold everyone's gaze.
UI_GFL2_OutfitDescription_pmx-b6889756cf: “Commander, remember those yam cakes we shared? Let's have some while we play games again. Hehe... Just like last time, there's a penalty if you lose to me.” Florence is all set for a heart-racing evening together before bed.
UI_GFL2_OutfitDescription_pmx-e524539529: The dress Makiatto wears to the ball. She paired the understated design with that familiar ribbon. She must be secretly hoping her dance partner will find her soon.
UI_GFL2_OutfitDescription_pmx-79e7c6a0e6: “D-don't look this way, you idiot.” Her voice and expression both give away how much she's been looking forward to this.
UI_GFL2_OutfitDescription_pmx-e348ab0b30: “All done! This dish is the stuff of legends. Come and try it!” She offers you a plate of golden fried rice, her smile as bright and confident as ever.
UI_GFL2_OutfitDescription_pmx-020f2e8bdc: “Commander, get plenty of rest and watch what you eat. Make sure you follow the meal plan I've laid out for you!” Perfectly balanced nutrition and good flavor go together in this restorative meal. It's Qiuhua's way of showing that she cares.
